## Summary

Implemented server-side getSession() resolving app_roles, app_groups, and app_permissions from JWT claims, created requirePermission() for page and action authorization, and built visibleNav / useFilteredNavGroups for dynamic sidebar and kbar menu filtering. Verified with 5 unit tests in nav.test.ts, TypeScript typecheck, oxlint, Next.js build, and pgTAP suite.

## Decisions

- **Use permission-based gating exclusively (C-17)**: Contract forbids branching on role names; code checks permission keys like 'users.read', 'roles.manage'.
- **Run pure navigation unit tests via Bun Test**: Fast, dependency-free testing of pure permission-filtering logic.
